journal_lines: The silence changed quality. Came back without something. Won't say why.
Something down there. Left quickly. Left something behind.
The deep took something. Trade seems fair given what was not taken.
Heard my own breath returned to me by the rock. The rock said something different than I had said.
A passage opened that I had not opened. Closed when I looked away. Did not look back.
Left an offering. Did not know it was an offering at the time.
The dark wanted one of the things I was carrying. I did not argue with the dark.
Came back missing nothing important. Missing one thing, anyway. Cannot remember what.
